scope:
The two off-circle unit-face corners at LRL and RLR G3 triples.
Exhaust1..4 WHITE histories and exact face levels; no global scan.
consequences: At a locally maximal C component, every LRL triple has singleton S; otherwise opposite C rises by2.
At a locally minimal L component, RLR cannot occur; the opposite L drops by1 or2 in every complete WHITE profile.
Essential simple physical circles have no three equal consecutive turns; with no RLR and zero signed turning, every turn run has length2 and the drift is axis.
warning: Axis restriction concerns a G3 circle touching a locally minimal L plateau, even if the plateau has odd corners. It is not a restriction on arbitrary local minima without such a circle.
